name: lot_developer_desirability_tolerance
description: Test 1 (§5.1, §16). TestDesirability seeds a temporary cRZRandom with (x << 16) + z (32-bit wrap) and draws RandomSint32RangeUniform(0, 7), giving r = 0..6; the tolerance is r + 2 (the number of consecutive low-desirability visits that pass). The first raw of each seed is pinned by the spec table, so the tolerance per location is fixed: (0,0) seed 0x00000000 raw 0 r 0 tol 2; (1,0) seed 0x00010000 raw 0x41C64E6D r 1 tol 3; (17,3) seed 0x00110003 raw 0x5E2BFA90 r 2 tol 4; (10,20) seed 0x000A0014 raw 0x91C433C0 r 3 tol 5; (64,37) seed 0x00400025 raw 0x719D1CE9 r 3 tol 5; (255,255) seed 0x00FF00FF raw 0x84C9A31B r 3 tol 5.
